relations.subject: Norman Fischer
relations.evidence: From 1970 through 1976, Fischer trained at the Berkeley Zen Center, a temple in the lineage of Shunryu Suzuki, under the guidance of Sojun Mel Weitsman.

relations.subject: Norman Fischer
